answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit jade bond and joins the audit atlas. Each epoch a comet beacon picks targets, one auditor each from the atlas. The target files a sample keyed to the comet seed; a failed audit burns the 70 bond, and a rented auditor's false pass slashes its jade seal by 35. Each fake pays 75: 25 fee, 30 sample, 20 rent; 1,000 fakes pay 75,000 per epoch plus 70,000 locked, while an honest agent pays 25 if drawn and keeps its bond.
